胡九郎闻言，沉默着点了点头，指尖轻轻摩挲着罗盘边缘，眼底满是复杂。范梦雪说得对，幻境的事像一根刺，扎在他心头，不跟杨童说清楚，不弄明白其中的蹊跷，他终究无法静下心来，甚至可能再做出触碰禁忌的事。

可真要开口，他又不知该从何说起，总不能告诉杨童，自己在幻境里和她上演了一场相恋又背叛的戏码吧？

“我知道了，等我神识再恢复些，就联系她。”

“师兄，你也别太钻牛角尖，不管幻境里是什么，杨姐姐总归是站在我们这边的。再说，苏笑笑还需要我们照顾，你得先养好精神才行。”

胡九郎点点头，重新靠在椅子上，闭上眼睛，继续调理神识。

里屋的苏笑笑睡得很沉，偶尔发出一声轻浅的呼吸，体内残留的阴气，正随着她的呼吸，一点点消散。

不知过了多久，卦铺的门被轻轻推开，一个身影走了进来，正是阡陌。

他手里提着一个食盒，脸上带着几分笑意，看到胡九郎和范梦雪，连忙说道：

“胡大哥，范姐姐；我来看看你们。”

胡九郎缓缓睁开眼睛，看到阡陌，眼底的凝重稍稍散去，点了点头，范梦雪起身迎了上去，笑着说道：“阡……陌？你怎么来了？还带了东西。”

“我经常来找胡大哥的，他时不时教我一点东西，名为兄弟，实为师徒，特意炖了些汤，来讨好胡大哥啊！”

阡陌笑着将食盒放在桌上，打开后一股浓郁的香气飘了出来，胡九郎闻了一下，察觉到是补气血的，说道：

“正好，笑笑需要补一补了！”

就在这时，里屋传来一阵轻微的动静，声音还有些虚弱，却带着几分俏皮。

“什么东西这么香？是不是有人给我带好吃的啦？”

范梦雪连忙走进里屋，扶着苏笑笑坐起身，笑着说道：“是阡陌来了，给你带了补汤。”

苏笑笑抬眼看向外屋的阡陌，眼底闪过一丝狡黠，故意皱了皱鼻子，装出一副严肃的模样，声音压低了几分，故作神秘地说道：

“哦？阡陌啊，你小心点，我可是赶尸人，身上带着尸气，小心沾到你身上，影响你的寿命哦。”

阡陌愣了一下，旋即哭笑不得。他故作紧张地拍了拍胸口，说道：

“哎呀，那可糟了，我这一身正气，可别被苏姑娘的‘尸气’污染了。”

“哈哈哈！”

苏笑笑忍不住笑了起来，脸色因为笑意，多了几分血色，她似乎经常逗阡陌。

苏笑笑目光落在阡陌带来的补汤上，眼睛一亮，说道：

“快给我尝尝，我都快饿死了，这几天浑身无力，连吃都没胃口。”

阡陌笑着盛了一碗汤，递到苏笑笑面前。

Hearing this, Hu Jiulang nodded silently, his fingertips gently rubbing the edge of the compass, his eyes full of complexity.Fan Mengxue was right. The fantasy was like a thorn in his heart. If he didn't explain it clearly to Yang Tong and understand the strangeness of it, he would not be able to calm down and might even do something taboo again.

But if he really wanted to speak, he didn't know where to start. He couldn't tell Yang Tong that he had staged a drama of falling in love and betrayal with her in the illusion, right?

"I understand. I will contact her when I regain my consciousness."

"Senior brother, don't be too impatient. No matter what is in the illusion, Sister Yang is always on our side. Besides, Su Xiaoxiao still needs our care, so you have to keep your spirits up first."

Hu Jiulang nodded, leaned back on the chair, closed his eyes, and continued to regulate his consciousness.

Su Xiaoxiao was sleeping deeply in the back room, occasionally letting out a shallow breath. The remaining yin energy in her body was dissipating little by little with her breathing.

After an unknown amount of time, the door of Gua Pu was gently pushed open, and a figure walked in, it was Qian Mo.

He was holding a food box in his hand, with a bit of a smile on his face. When he saw Hu Jiulang and Fan Mengxue, he said quickly:

"Brother Hu, Sister Fan; let me see you."

Hu Jiulang slowly opened his eyes and saw Qian Mo. The solemnity in his eyes dissipated slightly. He nodded. Fan Mengxue stood up and went to meet her. He said with a smile: "Qian... Mo? Why are you here? You brought something with you."

"I often come to see Brother Hu. He teaches me something from time to time. He is called a brother, but he is actually a master and disciple. He specially stewed some soup to please Brother Hu!"

Qian Mo smiled and put the food box on the table. After opening it, a strong aroma floated out. Hu Jiulang smelled it and realized that it was to replenish qi and blood, and said:

"Exactly, Xiaoxiao needs some replenishment!"

At this moment, there was a slight movement in the back room. The voice was still a little weak, but it was a bit playful.

"What smells so good? Did someone bring me something delicious?"

Fan Mengxue hurriedly walked into the back room, helped Su Xiaoxiao sit up, and said with a smile, "Qian Mo is here and brought you a tonic soup."

Su Xiaoxiao raised her eyes to look at the street in the outer room, with a hint of cunning flashing in her eyes. She wrinkled her nose deliberately, pretending to be serious, lowered her voice a bit, and said mysteriously:

"Oh? Qian Mo, please be careful. I am a corpse chaser. I carry corpse aura on my body. Be careful if it gets on you, it will affect your lifespan."

Qian Mo was stunned for a moment, and then he didn't know whether to laugh or cry.He patted his chest pretending to be nervous and said:

"Oh, that's too bad. I don't want my righteousness to be polluted by Miss Su's 'corpse energy'."

"Hahaha!"

Su Xiaoxiao couldn't help but laugh, her face became a little brighter because of her smile. She seemed to tease Qian Mo a lot.

Su Xiaoxiao's eyes fell on the tonic soup Qian Mo brought, her eyes lit up and she said:

"Give me a taste. I'm almost starving to death. I've been so weak these past few days and I don't even have the appetite to eat."

Qian Mo smiled and filled a bowl of soup and handed it to Su Xiaoxiao.
